claim_truth.subject: All Administrative Departments and Heads of Departments
claim_truth.object: the following terms and conditions while making engagements on contract basis
claim_truth.evidence_quote: All Administrative Departments and Heads of Departments should scrupulously follow the following terms and conditions while making engagements on contract basis :

claim_truth.subject: engagement on contract basis
claim_truth.object: be made except with prior approval of DP&AR and Finance Department, Government of Mizoram
claim_truth.evidence_quote: No engagement on contract basis shall be made except with prior approval of DP&AR and Finance Department, Government of Mizoram.

claim_truth.subject: contract employment
claim_truth.object: be resorted to by the Department with prior concurrence of the DP&AR and Finance Department and with final approval of the Chief Minister through Chief Secretary in the absence of specific sanctioned posts
claim_truth.evidence_quote: Provided that in certa in special circumstances, contract employment may be resorted to by the Department with prior concurrence of the DP&AR and Finance Department and with final approval of the Chief Minister through Chief Secretary in the absence of specific sanctioned posts.

claim_truth.subject: No formal appointment
claim_truth.object: be issued while making engagement on contract except after execution of Agreement in the prescribed form appended
claim_truth.evidence_quote: No formal appointment shall be issued while making engagement on contract except after execution of Agreement in the prescribed form appended.

claim_truth.subject: Period of engagement on contract basis
claim_truth.object: be for one year at the initial stage
claim_truth.evidence_quote: Period of engagement on contract basis shall be for one year at the initial stage.

claim_truth.subject: the appointing authority
claim_truth.object: their services for another period as it may deem fit and proper
conditions: they are found fit for further retention
claim_truth.evidence_quote: If they are found fit for further retention, the appointing authority may extend their services for another period as it may deem fit and proper.

claim_truth.subject: rate of monthly remuneration of contract employee
claim_truth.object: be equal to the minimum scale of pay attached to the post in which he/she in engaged plus 50% of that amount
claim_truth.evidence_quote: The rate of monthly remuneration of contract employee shall be equal to the minimum scale of pay attached to the post in which he/she in engaged plus 50% of that amount.

claim_truth.subject: Contract employees
claim_truth.object: be entitled to Medical Re -imbursement at par with other regular government servants
claim_truth.evidence_quote: All Contract employees shall be entitled to Medical Re -imbursement at par with other regular government servants.

claim_truth.subject: Contract employees
claim_truth.object: be required to subscribe to special security scheme as may be introduced by the Government of Mizoram from time to time
claim_truth.evidence_quote: Contract employees shall be required to subscribe to special security scheme as may be introduced by the Government of Mizoram from time to time.

claim_truth.subject: No household Peon
claim_truth.object: be provided to any contract employee
claim_truth.evidence_quote: No household Peon shall be provided to any contract employee.

claim_truth.subject: No residential telephone
claim_truth.object: be provided to any contract employee
claim_truth.evidence_quote: No residential telephone shall be provided to any contract employee.

claim_truth.subject: The emolument s for this purpose
claim_truth.object: be restricted to the existing remuneration drawn by the employee at the time of death or discharge from service
claim_truth.evidence_quote: The emolument s for this purpose shall be restricted to the existing remuneration drawn by the employee at the time of death or discharge from service.

claim_truth.subject: The emoluments for this purpose
claim_truth.object: be restricted to the existing remuneration drawn by the employee at the time of death or discharge from service
claim_truth.evidence_quote: The emoluments for this purpose shall be restricted to the existing remuneration drawn by the employee at the time of death or discharge from service.

claim_truth.subject: Moreover, TA/DA on official tour
claim_truth.object: also be admissible to all Contract employees at par with other regular Government servants
claim_truth.evidence_quote: Moreover, TA/DA on official tour shall also be admissible to all Contract employees at par with other regular Government servants.

claim_truth.subject: Service book
claim_truth.object: be maintained for each contract employee
claim_truth.evidence_quote: Service book shall be maintained for each contract employee.

claim_truth.subject: The party of the first part
claim_truth.object: be entitled to a remuneration at the rate Rs. /- p.m
claim_truth.evidence_quote: The party of the first part shall be entitled to a remuneration at the rate Rs.________ _________________/- p.m.
